fields.name: Expected_Interviews_Target__c
fields.label: Expected Interviews (Target)
fields.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Application_Start_Date__c) || TEXT(Niche__c) = "Other" || ISBLANK(TEXT(Niche__c)), 0, CASE(TEXT(Niche__c), "AI ML Engineer", 12, "Product/Project Manager", 6, "Java Fullstack Developer/Engineer", 8, "Python Developer/Engineer", 8, "Finance Analyst", 4, "Marketing Manager", 5, 0) * MAX(1, (YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Application_Start_Date__c)) * 12 + (MONTH(TODAY()) - MONTH(Application_Start_Date__c)) - IF(DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(Application_Start_Date__c), 1, 0) + 1) )
fields.description: Niche-based expected interview target that accumulates monthly. First month = the niche's monthly target; each completed month since Application Start Date adds one more month's target. Niche monthly targets: AI/ML 12, Full Stack (Java) 8, Python 8, PM 6, Marketing 5, Finance Analyst 4. Other/blank niche or no start date = 0. Replaces the flat, niche-agnostic Expected_No_of_Interviews__c for Target Achieved reporting.

fields.name: Is_Final_Week_Mock__c

fields.name: Last_Result_Reminder_At__c
fields.label: Last Result Reminder At
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent result-reminder email sent for this mock. Used with Result_Reminder_Count__c to prevent duplicate sends and for auditing/debugging. Populated by MockDeadlineEnforcer.sendResultReminders.
fields.helpText: When the most recent reminder email was sent. Auto-managed by MockDeadlineEnforcer.

fields.name: Result_Reminder_Count__c
fields.label: Result Reminder Count
fields.description: How many reminder emails have been sent to the interviewer to record the mock's Human_Decision. 0 = none, 1 = first sent (interviewer only, at mock end + 4 hours), 2 = second sent (interviewer + assigned trainer, at mock end + 7 hours). fields.name: Support_Block_Start__c

fields.name: Start_Time_Text__c
fields.label: Start Time Text
fields.formula: IF( VALUE(LEFT(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 2)) >= 12, TEXT(VALUE(LEFT(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 2)) - 12) & ":" & MID(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 4, 2) & " PM", IF( VALUE(LEFT(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 2)) = 0, "12:" & MID(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 4, 2) & " AM", LEFT(TEXT(Start_Time__c), 5) & " AM" ) )

fields.name: Submission_Rate__c
fields.label: Submission Rate
fields.description: Snapshot of the Submitted Bill Rate at the time of interview creation. Preserved even if rates change later. Used for historical margin reporting.
fields.helpText: Auto-populated from Job Submission Submitted Bill Rate when interview is created. Snapshot preserved for historical reporting accuracy.

fields.name: Weighted_Credit__c
fields.label: Weighted Credit
fields.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL( Interview_Status__c , "Completed"), Base_Credit__c * Round_Multiplier_New__c, null )

fields.name: Is_Primary__c
fields.label: Is Primary
fields.description: Primary Interviewer/Recruiter

fields.name: Program_Version__c
fields.label: Program Version
fields.description: One program version owns many interview types. Blank = global type (hiring interviews).

fields.name: Requires_Hired_Niche__c
fields.label: Requires Hired Niche
fields.description: Conduct summary shows the Hired Niche picker for this type (config-not-code, replaces the Intake-by-name hardcode).

fields.name: Uses_Retake_Decision__c
fields.label: Uses Retake Decision
fields.description: Decision set Pass/Retake/Fail instead of Pass/Fail/Needs Improvement.

fields.name: ACH_Amount__c
fields.label: ACH Amount
fields.helpText: Total Salary x Agreement %. Auto-calculated.

fields.name: Agreement_Percent__c
fields.label: Agreement %
fields.helpText: Agreement percentage applied to Total Salary to get the ACH Amount (e.g. 20 for 20%).

fields.name: Amount_Paid__c
fields.label: Amount Paid
fields.description: The amount paid so far

fields.name: Annual_Salary__c
fields.label: Annual Salary
fields.helpText: Candidate's annual salary. Used by the ACH calculator to derive the ACH amount.

fields.name: Bank_Account_Last4__c
fields.label: Bank Account (Last 4)
fields.description: Masked last 4 digits of the customer's bank account as returned by QuickBooks Payments. Full account/routing numbers are NEVER stored in Salesforce.
fields.helpText: Masked last 4 digits returned by QuickBooks after the bank account is created. No full bank numbers are stored here.

fields.name: Bank_Setup_Summary__c
fields.label: Bank Setup Summary
fields.description: Masked, human-readable summary of what the CS person did for the bank/payment method during Setup (new bank added / reused existing / skipped in test mode). Never contains full account or routing numbers.
fields.helpText: Masked summary of the bank action taken during setup. No full bank numbers.

fields.name: Bonus_Amount__c
fields.label: Bonus (if any)
fields.helpText: Candidate's bonus, if any. Added to Annual Salary to get Total Salary.

fields.name: Candidate__c
fields.label: Candidate
fields.description: Links invoice to Candidate

fields.name: Charge_Interest__c
fields.label: Charge Interest
fields.helpText: When checked, interest is added to the plan (ACH Amount x Interest Rate per Cycle x Number of Cycles).

fields.name: Day_Of_Month__c
fields.label: Day of Month
fields.helpText: Day of month to charge (e.g., 15 = 15th of each month)

fields.name: Due_Date__c
fields.label: Due Date
fields.description: Date when the invoice is due

fields.name: Interest_Amount__c
fields.label: Interest Amount
fields.helpText: When Charge Interest is on: ACH Amount x Interest Rate/Cycle x Number of Cycles. Otherwise 0.

fields.name: Interest_Rate_Per_Cycle__c
fields.label: Interest Rate / Cycle
fields.helpText: Interest rate charged per cycle/EMI (default 2%). Total interest = ACH Amount x this rate x Number of Cycles.

fields.name: Interval__c
fields.label: Interval
fields.helpText: 1 = each cycle, 2 = every other cycle, etc.

fields.name: Invoice_Amount__c
fields.label: Invoice Amount
fields.description: Total amount for the invoice

fields.name: Last_Recurring_Action__c
fields.label: Last Recurring Action
fields.description: The most recent action performed on this recurring plan via the Manage Recurring Plan flow (e.g. Change Amount, Pause, Resume). Used to trigger the recurring-plan change Slack notification.

fields.name: Lead__c
fields.label: Lead
fields.description: Links invoice to Lead

fields.name: Monthly_Revenue__c
fields.label: Monthly Revenue
fields.formula: CASE( TEXT(Frequency__c), "Daily", Recurring_Amount__c * 30 / Interval__c, "Weekly", Recurring_Amount__c * 4 / Interval__c, "Monthly", Recurring_Amount__c / Interval__c, "Yearly", Recurring_Amount__c / (12 * Interval__c), 0 )

fields.name: Number_of_Months__c
fields.label: Number of Cycles
fields.helpText: Total cycles (leave blank for unlimited)

fields.name: Outstanding_Amount__c
fields.label: Outstanding Amount
fields.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Recurring"), IF( ISBLANK(Number_of_Months__c), null, (Recurring_Amount__c * Number_of_Months__c) - Total_Amount_Collected__c ), Invoice_Amount__c - Amount_Paid__c )

fields.name: QB_Bank_Account_Id__c
fields.label: QB Bank Account Id
fields.description: QuickBooks Payments bank-account id returned when the customer's bank account was created via the Send Bank Details flow.

fields.name: QB_Doc_Number__c
fields.label: QB Doc Number
fields.helpText: QuickBooks invoice document number (auto-generated by QuickBooks when Custom Transaction Numbers is off).

fields.name: QB_Recur_Data_Ref__c
fields.label: QB Recur Data Ref
fields.description: QuickBooks RecurDataRef.value of the recurring template. Every Sales Receipt QuickBooks auto-generates from this plan carries the same RecurDataRef, so incoming receipt webhooks are matched back to this plan on this field.

fields.name: Recurring_Plan__c
fields.label: Recurring Plan
fields.helpText: The plan selected for this recurring receipt (from the QB_Plan custom setting). Its QuickBooks Item Number is looked up from the custom setting when the receipt is created.

fields.name: Recurring_Template_Name__c
fields.label: Recurring Template Name
fields.helpText: e.g., "Career Coaching - Monthly"

fields.name: Schedule_Description__c
fields.label: Schedule Description
fields.formula: "Every " & IF(Interval__c = 1, "", TEXT(Interval__c) & " ") & CASE( TEXT(Frequency__c), "Daily", IF(Interval__c = 1, "day", "days"), "Weekly", IF(Interval__c = 1, "week", "weeks"), "Monthly", IF(Interval__c = 1, "month", "months"), "Yearly", IF(Interval__c = 1, "year", "years"), "" )

fields.name: Slack_Owner_Thread_Ts__c
fields.label: Slack Owner Thread Ts
fields.helpText: Slack message timestamp of the owner DM thread root (first sales-receipt DM to the invoice owner). Used to thread later payment/update DMs.

fields.name: Slack_Thread_Ts__c
fields.label: Slack Thread Ts
fields.helpText: Timestamp/ID of the first Slack message posted for this recurring plan. Used to thread follow-up messages.

fields.name: Total_Plan_Value__c
fields.label: Total Plan Value
fields.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Recurring"), IF( ISBLANK(Number_of_Months__c), null, Recurring_Amount__c * Number_of_Months__c ), Invoice_Amount__c )
fields.description: Total contract value. For recurring plans = Recurring Amount x Number of Months (cycles); blank when the plan is open-ended (no cycle count). For one-time invoices = Invoice Amount.
fields.helpText: Total value of the plan across all cycles (per-cycle amount x number of cycles). Blank for open-ended plans.

fields.name: Total_Salary__c
fields.label: Total Salary
fields.helpText: Annual Salary + Bonus. Auto-calculated.

fields.name: Type__c
fields.label: Type
fields.helpText: Select "Recurring" for subscription billing

fields.name: Account_Manager__c
fields.label: Account Manager
fields.description: The Techsara Account Manager responsible for this job requirement. Auto-populated from Client Account Account Manager field on creation.
fields.helpText: Select the Account Manager handling this requirement. Auto-populated from the client account. Can be changed if needed.

fields.name: Client_Account__c
fields.label: Client Account
fields.description: The B2B Client or Vendor account that sent this job requirement. MUST be a business account. Candidate Person Accounts are NOT allowed.
fields.helpText: Select the client or vendor company that sent this requirement. Only B2B Client and Vendor accounts are valid. Validation rule will block Candidate accounts.

fields.name: Client_Bill_Rate__c
fields.label: Client Bill Rate
fields.description: SENSITIVE. The rate Techsara charges the client per hour/day/salary. Visible only to Account Manager and Leadership. Never shown to Recruiters or on website.
fields.helpText: Enter the agreed bill rate with the client. This is the rate Techsara charges. Keep confidential. Not visible to Recruiters or on website.

fields.name: Client_Company__c
fields.label: Client Company
fields.description: This field is used to store the client company instead of client account until we don't have b2b client converted into b2b client account.
fields.helpText: This field indicates the client company instead of client account until we don't have b2b client converted into b2b client account.

fields.name: Client_Contact__c
fields.label: Client Contact
fields.description: Optional hiring manager or vendor contact for this requirement. Used for interview scheduling and submission emails.
fields.helpText: Select the client contact who sent this requirement or who should receive candidate profiles. Leave blank if not known yet.

fields.name: Client_Lead__c
fields.label: Client Lead
fields.description: This field is used to store the client lead instead of client contact until we don't have b2b client converted into b2b client account.
fields.helpText: This field indicates the client lead instead of client contact until we don't have b2b client converted into b2b client account.

fields.name: Duration__c
fields.label: Duration
fields.description: Expected duration of the contract or project. Used for candidate matching and website display.
fields.helpText: Enter the expected duration. Example: 6 months, 12 months, Long-term, Permanent, 3 months with extension.

fields.name: Employment_Type__c
fields.label: Employment Type
fields.description: Type of employment arrangement for this role. Determines tax and payment structure for the candidate.
fields.helpText: Select the employment type. Contract = direct contractor. C2C = corp-to-corp. W2 = W2 employee. Full-Time = permanent employee. Contract-to-Hire = starts contract, may convert.

fields.name: Estimated_Margin__c
fields.label: Estimated Margin
fields.description: SENSITIVE. Auto-calculated difference between Client Bill Rate and Target Candidate Rate. Visible only to Account Manager and Leadership.
fields.helpText: Auto-calculated from Client Bill Rate minus Target Candidate Rate. Represents estimated profit margin. Visible only to authorized users.

fields.name: External_Job_ID__c
fields.label: External Job ID
fields.description: Unique public reference ID for website integration. Auto-generated on record creation. Used to link website applications back to correct Job Requirement.
fields.helpText: Auto-generated by Flow on creation. Used in website URLs and application forms to link applicants to correct Job Requirement. Do not edit manually.

fields.name: Job_Description__c
fields.label: Job Description
fields.description: INTERNAL full job description. Contains all details including client name, internal notes, rates. NEVER shown on website. Use Public Website Description for website.
fields.helpText: Enter the complete internal job description. Include all client details, technical requirements, interview process. This is NEVER shown on the website.

fields.name: Job_Status__c
fields.label: Job Status
fields.description: Current status of the job requirement. Controls whether team can submit candidates and whether job can be published to website.
fields.helpText: Select current status of this Job Requirement

fields.name: Job_Title__c
fields.label: Job Title
fields.description: The title of the open position the client needs to fill. Displayed on website listings and used for candidate matching.
fields.helpText: Enter the job title exactly as the client provided. Example: Salesforce Developer, Java Backend Engineer, AI/ML Engineer, DevOps Consultant.

fields.name: Last_Notification_Sent__c
fields.label: Last Notification Sent
fields.description: Stores when the last urgent reminder was sent, for the 4-hour loop
fields.helpText: Stores when the last urgent reminder was sent, for the 4-hour loop

fields.name: Location__c
fields.label: Location
fields.description: City, state, or remote designation for this job requirement. Displayed on website listings.
fields.helpText: Enter the job location. Example: New Jersey, , Austin TX, New York City, Hybrid - Chicago. Shown on website listings.

fields.name: Max_Submissions_Allowed__c
fields.label: Max Submissions Allowed
fields.description: Optional maximum number of candidate profiles the client will accept. Prevents over-submitting when client has a strict profile limit.
fields.helpText: Enter the maximum profiles the client will review. Leave blank if client has no limit. System will warn when this limit is approached.

fields.name: Minimum_Experience_Required__c
fields.label: Experience Required
fields.description: this field is to show minimum required experience to our website.
fields.helpText: this field is used to show required experience to website.

fields.name: Number_of_Openings__c
fields.label: Number of Openings
fields.description: How many positions the client needs to fill for this requirement. Used to determine when Job Requirement should be marked as Filled.
fields.helpText: Enter the number of positions to fill. Default is 1. When this many candidates are placed, Job Requirement can be marked Filled.

fields.name: Other_Closure_Reason__c
fields.label: Other Closure Reason
fields.description: Stores the user-provided reason when Reason Closed is set to Other for a Job Requirement. This field captures additional details that are not covered by the predefined close reason values.
fields.helpText: Enter Job Requirement closure reason when 'Other' is selected.

fields.name: Primary_Skills__c
fields.label: Primary Skills
fields.description: Main technical and functional skills required for this role. Used for candidate matching and displayed on website listings.
fields.helpText: List the required skills. Example: Salesforce Apex, LWC, Integration (REST/SOAP), Admin certified. Be specific to help recruiters match candidates accurately.

fields.name: Priority__c
fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Urgency level of this job requirement. Critical and High priority jobs trigger automatic notifications to Account Manager.
fields.helpText: Set to Critical for same-day needs. High for 24-48 hour deadline. Medium for 3-5 days. Low for flexible timeline. Critical and High trigger AM notifications.

fields.name: Public_Website_Description__c
fields.label: Public Website Description
fields.description: Clean website-safe job description shown to candidates. Must NOT contain client name (if confidential), internal rates, or internal notes. Required when Website Status = Published.
fields.helpText: Write a clean, public-friendly job description. Do NOT include client name if confidential, internal rates, or internal notes. This is shown to all website visitors.

fields.name: Publish_to_Website__c
fields.label: Job Post on Website
fields.description: Controls whether this job is eligible for website listing. Must be true along with Website Status = Published for job to appear on website.
fields.helpText: Check to make this job eligible for website posting. Also requires Website Status = Published and Public Description to be filled.

fields.name: Rate_Type__c
fields.label: Rate Type
fields.description: Whether the bill rate and candidate rate are hourly, salary, or daily. Defaults to Hourly for contract positions.
fields.helpText: Select Hourly for contract/C2C/W2 positions. Salary for full-time permanent roles. Daily for some consulting arrangements.

fields.name: Reason_for_JR_Closure__c
fields.label: Reason for JR Closure
fields.description: Reason why the job requirement was closed. Used for reporting and understanding client patterns.
fields.helpText: Select the reason when closing Job Requirement.

fields.name: Required_Visa_Status__c
fields.label: Required Visa Status
fields.description: Work authorization types the client will accept for this role. Used to filter candidates by visa status during matching.
fields.helpText: Select all visa types the client accepts. Leave blank or select Any if client accepts all work authorizations. This filters candidates in the submission flow.

fields.name: Requirement_Received_Date_Time__c
fields.label: Requirement Received Date/Time
fields.description: Date and time the requirement was received from the client. Auto-populated by Record-Triggered Flow on record creation. Used for SLA reporting.
fields.helpText: Auto-populated when Job Requirement is created. Do not edit manually. Used to calculate average time to first submission in dashboards.

fields.name: Show_Client_Name_on_Website__c
fields.label: Show Client Name on Website
fields.description: Controls whether client name is shown on website job listing. Overridden by Confidential Client flag on Account â€” confidential clients are always hidden.
fields.helpText: Check to show client name on website. If Confidential Client is checked on the Account, client name will NEVER show regardless of this setting.

fields.name: SLA_Status__c
fields.label: SLA Status
fields.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Job_Status__c, "Filled"), ISPICKVAL(Job_Status__c, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Job_Status__c, "Cancelled"), ISPICKVAL(Job_Status__c, "Expired") ), "Closed", IF( ISBLANK(Submission_Deadline__c), "", IF( DATEVALUE(Submission_Deadline__c) < TODAY(), "Overdue", IF( DATEVALUE(Submission_Deadline__c) = TODAY(), "Due Today", "On Track" ) ) ) )
fields.description: Auto-calculated SLA status based on Submission Deadline and Job Status. Used in list views and dashboards to highlight urgent jobs.
fields.helpText: Auto-calculated. On Track = deadline is future. Due Today = deadline is today. Overdue = deadline has passed but job still Open. Closed = job is Filled/Closed/Cancelled.

fields.name: Submission_Deadline__c
fields.label: Submission Deadline
fields.description: The deadline by which candidate profiles must be submitted to the client. Required when Job Status = Open. Used for SLA tracking and urgency alerts.
fields.helpText: Enter the date and time by which profiles must be submitted to the client. Required when job is Open. Drives SLA Status calculation and 24-hour alert automation.

fields.name: Target_Candidate_Rate__c
fields.label: Target Candidate Rate
fields.description: SENSITIVE. Expected pay rate for the candidate. Used with Client Bill Rate to plan margin. Visible only to Account Manager and Leadership.
fields.helpText: Enter the target pay rate for candidates. Combined with Client Bill Rate to calculate Estimated Margin. Keep confidential.

fields.name: Website_Status__c
fields.label: Job Posting Status
fields.description: Controls website listing visibility. Draft = not public. Published = eligible to show if all conditions met. Unpublished = removed from website but job stays open.
fields.helpText: Draft = not visible on website. Published = will show on website if job is Open and deadline is future. Unpublished = removed from website, job can stay Open internally.

fields.name: Work_Mode__c
fields.label: Work Mode
fields.description: Whether the role is remote, hybrid, or fully onsite. Displayed on website listings and used for candidate matching.
fields.helpText: Select the work arrangement for this role. Remote = fully remote. Hybrid = mix of remote and office. Onsite = full time at client location.

fields.name: Account_Manager__c
fields.label: Account Manager
fields.description: Account Manager responsible for reviewing and approving this submission. Auto-populated from Job Requirement Account Manager field.
fields.helpText: Auto-populated from the Job Requirement. Shows which AM needs to review and approve this submission.

fields.name: Applicant_Email__c
fields.label: Applicant Email
fields.description: For asking applicant Email
fields.helpText: For asking applicant Email

fields.name: Applicant_Name__c
fields.label: Applicant Name
fields.description: Applicant Name for candidate
fields.helpText: Applicant Name for candidate

fields.name: Availability__c
fields.label: Availability
fields.description: When the candidate is available to start or interview. Entered by recruiter during submission. Shared with client.
fields.helpText: Enter candidate availability. Example: Immediate, 2 weeks notice, Available from June 15, Currently on project until July.

fields.name: Candidate__c
fields.label: Candidate
fields.description: The candidate (Person Account) being submitted for this job. MUST be a Candidate Person Account. Business Accounts not allowed. Validation rule enforces this.
fields.helpText: Select the candidate you are submitting. Only Candidate Person Accounts are valid. The Submit Candidate Profile flow filters to show only Person Accounts.

fields.name: Candidate_Rate__c
fields.label: Candidate Rate
fields.description: The rate the candidate expects or has agreed to. Entered by recruiter during submission. Used to calculate Expected Margin.
fields.helpText: Enter the candidate expected hourly rate or salary. For hourly enter per-hour rate. For salary enter annual amount. Required for margin calculation.

fields.name: Candidate_Summary__c
fields.label: Candidate Summary
fields.description: Short pitch written by the recruiter about why this candidate fits the role. Reviewed by AM before client submission. Can be included in client submission email.
fields.helpText: Write a compelling 3-5 sentence summary of why this candidate is a good fit. Include years of experience, key skills, and availability. AM reviews before sending to client.

fields.name: Client_Feedback__c
fields.label: Client Feedback
fields.description: Feedback received from the client after reviewing this candidate or after interview. Entered by AM. Used for reporting and improving future submissions.
fields.helpText: Enter client feedback about this candidate. Example: Rate too high, Strong technical fit but location concern, Interested - scheduling interview. Updated after client response.

fields.name: Client_Submission_Date_Time__c
fields.label: Client Submission Date/Time
fields.description: Date and time when AM submitted this profile to the client. Auto-set by Approve and Submit to Client flow. Required by validation rule when status = Submitted to Client.
fields.helpText: Auto-set when AM runs Approve and Submit to Client flow. Used to measure time from internal submission to client submission.

fields.name: Expected_Margin__c
fields.label: Expected Margin
fields.description: SENSITIVE. Auto-calculated difference between Submitted Bill Rate and Candidate Rate. Represents actual margin on this submission. Visible only to AM and Leadership.
fields.helpText: Auto-calculated. Shows expected profit margin for this specific submission. Visible only to Account Managers and Leadership.

fields.name: Internal_Submission_Date_Time__c
fields.label: Internal Submission Date/Time
fields.description: Date and time when the team member submitted this candidate profile. Auto-populated by the Submit Candidate Profile flow.
fields.helpText: Auto-populated when team submits candidate via flow. Used to measure time from requirement received to first internal submission.

fields.name: Interview_Requested__c
fields.label: Interview Requested
fields.description: Checked automatically when an Interview record is created from this submission via the Create Interview flow. Used in Interview Requested list view.
fields.helpText: Auto-checked by Create Interview flow. Do not manually edit. Used to filter submissions that have interviews in the Interview Requested/Scheduled list view.

fields.name: Job_Requirement__c
fields.label: Job Requirement
fields.description: Parent Job Requirement record for this submission. Links this candidate submission to the specific open job.
fields.helpText: Select the Job Requirement this candidate is being submitted for. Required field. Cannot be changed after creation.

fields.name: Lead__c
fields.label: Lead
fields.description: Linked Lead record for website applicants. Used when JS is created from a Lead before the candidate is converted to a Person Account. Enables tracking applicant history.
fields.helpText: Auto-set by Flow 7 (Website Lead to JS) when creating JS from a website applicant Lead. Either Candidate or Lead must be filled (validation rule enforces this).

fields.name: Offer_Received__c
fields.label: Offer Received
fields.description: Checked automatically when Interview Outcome = Offer Received via Interview Outcome Sync flow. Indicates client has made an offer to this candidate.
fields.helpText: Auto-checked by Interview Outcome Sync flow when client makes offer. Used for offer tracking and conversion ratio reporting.

fields.name: Placement_Status__c
fields.label: Placement Status
fields.description: Final placement outcome for this candidate submission. Updated manually by AM or automatically by Interview Outcome Sync flow.
fields.helpText: Select the final placement outcome. Not Placed = default. Offered = offer received. Placed = candidate started. Lost = offer declined or fell through.

fields.name: Rate_Type__c
fields.label: Rate Type
fields.description: Whether rates are hourly, salary, or daily. Defaults from Job Requirement Rate Type field.
fields.helpText: Select Hourly for contract positions, Salary for full-time, Daily for daily consulting rates. Defaults from Job Requirement.

fields.name: Rejection_Reason__c
fields.label: Rejection Reason
fields.description: Reason why this candidate was rejected either internally or by the client. Used for dashboard reporting and improving submission quality.
fields.helpText: Select the rejection reason when marking a submission as Rejected. Used in Rejected Submissions by Reason dashboard component.

fields.name: Skills_Match_Notes__c
fields.label: Skills Match Notes
fields.description: Detailed notes explaining why this candidate matches the job requirements. Written by recruiter. Reviewed by AM before client submission.
fields.helpText: Explain how the candidate skills match the job requirements point by point. Example: Job requires Apex - Candidate has 5 years Apex experience.

fields.name: Submission_Status__c
fields.label: Submission Status
fields.description: Current status of this candidate submission in the pipeline. Updated manually by AM and automatically by Interview Outcome Sync flow.
fields.helpText: Suggested by Team = internal suggestion. Pending AM Review = waiting for AM. Submitted to Client = AM approved and sent. Placed = candidate started.

fields.name: Submitted_Bill_Rate__c
fields.label: Submitted Bill Rate
fields.description: SENSITIVE. The rate AM submitted to the client for this candidate. Entered during Approve and Submit to Client flow. Required when status = Submitted to Client.
fields.helpText: Enter the hourly or salary rate being submitted to the client. This may differ from Client Bill Rate on Job Requirement if AM negotiated differently.

fields.name: Submitted_By__c
fields.label: Submitted By
fields.description: The Techsara team member who submitted this candidate profile. Auto-populated with the running user in the Submit Candidate Profile flow.
fields.helpText: Auto-populated with the user who ran the Submit Candidate Profile flow. Used for recruiter performance reporting.

fields.name: Unique_Submission_Key__c
fields.label: Unique Submission Key
fields.description: Combination of Job Requirement ID and Candidate ID that prevents duplicate submissions. Auto-generated by Submit Candidate Profile flow. Enforces one submission per candidate per job.
fields.helpText: Auto-generated by Submit Candidate Profile flow as Job Req ID + Candidate ID. If a duplicate submission is attempted, the flow will show an error and stop.

fields.name: Visa_Confirmation__c
fields.label: Visa Confirmation
fields.description: Snapshot of candidate visa status at time of submission. Entered by recruiter from candidate record. Shared with client in submission.
fields.helpText: Enter the candidate visa or work authorization status. Example: US Citizen, Green Card Holder, H1B (valid through 2027). Confirm with candidate before entering.

fields.name: Applied_Job_Requirement__c
fields.label: Applied Job Requirement
fields.description: Links website applicant lead to the specific Job Requirement they applied for. Populated automatically via website External Job ID matching.
fields.helpText: This field auto-populates when a candidate applies from the website. The system matches Website Job External ID to External Job ID on Job Requirement.

fields.name: B2B_Company_Type__c
fields.label: B2B Company Type
fields.description: Identifies the type of B2B company relationship. Direct Client hires directly. Vendor and Implementation Partners are middle-layer companies.
fields.helpText: Identifies the type of B2B company relationship. Direct Client hires directly. Vendor and Implementation Partners are middle-layer companies.

fields.name: Candidate_Rate_Expectation__c
fields.label: Candidate Rate Expectation
fields.description: Candidate expected hourly or salary rate. Captured during initial lead creation or website application. Used for job matching and submission planning.
fields.helpText: Enter the candidate expected rate. For hourly contractors enter hourly rate (e.g. 65.00). For full-time roles enter annual salary (e.g. 120000.00).

fields.name: Converted_to_Job_Requirement__c
fields.label: Converted to Job Requirement
fields.description: Indicates whether a Job Requirement has been created after this lead was qualified and converted to a Client Account.
fields.helpText: Check this box after you have created the Job Requirement record for this client. Helps track which B2B leads have been fully processed.

fields.name: Criminal_Record_Declaration__c
fields.label: Criminal Record Declaration
picklistValues: I do NOT have any criminal record

fields.name: Department__c
fields.label: Department
fields.description: This field is used to store lead's department.
fields.helpText: Enter lead's department

fields.name: Designation__c
fields.label: Designation
fields.description: This field is used to store the lead's designation.
fields.helpText: Enter above contact person's designation associated with company.

fields.name: Estimated_Bill_Rate__c
fields.label: Estimated Bill Rate
fields.description: Initial estimated bill rate the B2B client is willing to pay. Captured during early client discussions. This is an estimate only.
fields.helpText: Enter the estimated hourly or salary rate the client mentioned during initial discussions. This is not the final agreed rate.

fields.name: Lead_Category__c
fields.label: Lead Category
fields.description: Identifies whether this lead is a candidate prospect or a B2B client prospect.Used for reporting and filtering.
fields.helpText: Select "Candidate" for job seekers and placement prospects. Select "B2B Client" for companies sending job requirements

fields.name: Lead_Status__c
fields.label: Lead Status (not use)
fields.description: This field is to track the progress of B2B client company or B2B candidates.

fields.name: Preferred_Work_Mode__c
fields.label: Preferred Work Mode

fields.name: Session_Type__c
fields.label: Session Type
fields.description: Whether sessions for this program are one-on-one or group-based. Blank when Auto-Create Sessions is off.

fields.name: Booking_Mode__c
fields.label: Booking Mode
fields.description: How candidate-side booking works. Anytime = candidate picks any time within trainer availability. Fixed Schedule = candidate must pick one of the pre-defined session windows.

fields.name: Booking_Owner__c
fields.label: Booking Owner
fields.description: Who books each session â€” the trainer (manual scheduling) or the candidate (self-service).

fields.name: Duration_Days__c
fields.label: Duration (Days)
fields.description: Total number of days the program runs. Drives per-day session generation for Group Session programs.

fields.name: Has_Mock__c
fields.label: Include Mock Interview
fields.description: True when this program version includes a mock interview. Unlocks the other Mock_* configuration fields.

fields.name: Mock_Blocks_Progress__c
fields.label: Mock Blocks Progress
fields.description: When true, a candidate cannot proceed to the next mock cycle (e.g. next week) until the current mock is booked and attended. Runtime enforcement lives in the candidate portal.

fields.name: Mock_Booking_Owner__c
fields.label: Mock Booking Owner
fields.description: Who schedules the mock interview session â€” the trainer (manual) or the candidate (self-service).

fields.name: Mock_Booking_Window_Days__c
fields.label: Mock Booking Window (working days)
fields.description: How many working days BEFORE the mock date the candidate portal opens the slot picker. Default 4. Change per-program if this cohort needs a wider/tighter booking window.

fields.name: Mock_Cadence_Day__c
fields.label: Mock Cadence Day
fields.description: Day of the week regular weekly mocks land on. Default Monday. Combined with the cadence rule: mock date = this weekday of the next week after training-week ends.

fields.name: Mock_Duration_Min__c
fields.label: Mock Duration (min)
fields.description: Duration of each mock interview in minutes. Drives how the candidate portal slices interviewer calendar availability into bookable slots (e.g. 60 -> hour-long 07-08, 08-09, ... slots inside org Business Hours minus each interviewer's existing Events).

fields.name: Mock_Failure_Requires_Retake__c
fields.label: Mock Failure Requires Retake
fields.description: When true, a candidate who fails a mock interview must retake the corresponding training cycle (per the retake logic â€” fall back to earlier weeks if the current week has no capacity).

fields.name: Mock_Final_Week_Day__c
fields.label: Mock Final Week Day
fields.description: Day of the week the FINAL-week mock lands on (typically the last working day of the training itself, not the following Monday). Default Friday.

fields.name: Mock_Frequency__c
fields.label: Mock Frequency
fields.description: How often the mock interview recurs during this program.

fields.name: Mock_Interviewer_Group__c
fields.label: Mock Interviewer Public Group
fields.description: DeveloperName (API name) of the Salesforce Public Group whose members can conduct mock interviews for this program. Populated via a dropdown in the Program Creation flow (queries all Regular Public Groups at runtime). If blank, the portal falls back to a default group name. Enables different programs to use different interviewer pools -- e.g. AI_ML_Mock_Interviewers, Resume_Mock_Interviewers.

fields.name: Mock_Miss_Action__c
fields.label: Mock Miss Action
fields.description: What happens when the trainer misses the result deadline. Drop Training = auto-drop cascade fires. Warn Only = flag on record but no drop. Notify Admin = create task/email to admin. Default Drop Training.

fields.name: Mock_Overflow_Threshold__c
fields.label: Mock Overflow Threshold
fields.description: Overflow threshold for mock booking. When a mock day's total remaining availability is at or below this number, MockAvailabilityService opens the next working day (skipping weekends and holidays) and cascades forward until pending mocks can be scheduled. Read by MockAvailabilityService; defaults to 3 if blank.
fields.helpText: When a mock day's remaining interviewer openings (summed across its time slots) drop to this number or below, the next working day is also opened for mock booking. Leave blank to use the default of 3.

fields.name: Mock_Reschedule_Lock_Days__c
fields.label: Mock Reschedule Lock (working days)
fields.description: Number of working days before the mock date when a booked slot can no longer be rescheduled by the candidate. Default 2.

fields.name: Mock_Result_Deadline_Days__c
fields.label: Mock Result Deadline (working days)
fields.description: Number of working days AFTER the mock date the trainer has to record a result (Pass/Fail). If no result recorded by then, the Mock Miss Action fires. Default 3.

fields.name: Mock_Slot_Granularity_Min__c
fields.label: Mock Slot Granularity (min)
fields.description: Slot slicing size in minutes. 60 = hour-aligned slots (07-08, 08-09). 30 = half-hour slots. 15 = quarter-hour slots. Default 60.

fields.name: Session_Duration__c
fields.label: Session Duration
fields.description: Duration of each session window in minutes. Restricted picklist with 15-minute intervals up to 3 hours. Value is the numeric minute count as a string (e.g. "60") so Apex/JS can Number() it directly.

fields.name: Session_Duration_Min__c
fields.label: Session Duration (Min) [Deprecated]
fields.description: DEPRECATED â€” replaced by Session_Duration__c (Picklist). Kept only because obsolete flow versions still reference it. Do not use in new automation.

fields.name: Session_Type__c
fields.label: Session Type
fields.description: Whether sessions for this program version are one-on-one or group-based. Copied from Program.Session_Type at version creation; can be overridden per version.

fields.name: Sessions_Per_Day__c
fields.label: Sessions Per Day
fields.description: Number of session windows per day when Booking Mode is Fixed Schedule. Used by the Program Creation wizard to generate the correct number of Session Window template rows.

fields.name: COMPASS_State_Last_Saved_UTC__c

fields.helpText: UTC timestamp of the most recent COMPASS run that wrote to COMPASS_State_JSON __c. Use this to spot stale/skipped employees.

fields.name: COMPASS_State_Schema_Version__c
fields.label: COMPASS State Schema Version
fields.helpText: version of the JSON blob in COMPASS_State_JSON __c. Enables safe evolution of the blob format in future Lambda releases.

fields.name: Domain_Type__c
fields.label: Domain Type
fields.description: Whether this section applies to technical roles, non-technical roles, or both. Used by Techsara's Magic mode to fetch sections matching the Niche Domain Type.
fields.helpText: Tech = technical roles only, Non-Tech = non-technical roles only, Both = applies to all.

fields.name: Exclude_Source_Section__c

fields.label: Source Interview Type
fields.description: REVIEW SECTION: pull questions as if the interview type were this mock (e.g. Final Mock Week 1 pulls Mock 1 pools).

fields.name: Source_Section__c
fields.label: Source Section (only)
fields.description: Review section: only this source section's questions.

fields.description: Order of this section within this specific interview type. Because a section can belong to several interview types with a different order in each, the per-type sequence lives on this junction rather than on Section__c.Interview_Sequence__c.

fields.name: Candidate_Email__c
fields.label: Candidate Email
fields.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Candidate__c)), Candidate__r.Email_replica__c , IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Lead__c)), Lead__r.Email, IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Onboarding__c)), Onboarding__r.Account__r.Email_replica__c , "" ) ) )

fields.name: Candidate_Name__c
fields.label: Candidate Name
fields.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Candidate__c)), Candidate__r.FirstName &" "& Candidate__r.LastName, IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Lead__c)), Lead__r.FirstName & " " & Lead__r.LastName, IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Onboarding__c)), Onboarding__r.Account__r.FirstName & " " & Onboarding__r.Account__r.LastName , "" ) ) )

fields.name: Cohort__c
fields.label: Cohort
fields.description: Cohort this Session belongs to. Populated by booking flow.

fields.name: Session_Window__c
fields.label: Session Window
fields.description: Session Window this Session belongs to. Keys the createOrAttachSessions lookup.

fields.name: Candidate__c
fields.label: Candidate
fields.description: The attending candidate (Account). Denormalized for portal query convenience so we can filter attendees by candidate id in one SOQL hop instead of joining through Candidate_Training.

fields.name: Candidate_Training__c
fields.label: Candidate Training
fields.description: The attending candidate's training. Session_Attendee links a shared Session to this training so the candidate's portal can surface it.

fields.name: Candidate_Training_Step__c
fields.label: Candidate Training Step
fields.description: The attendee's step that corresponds to this master session (matched by Sequence). When the master Session completes, this per-candidate step gets marked Completed and its deliverables activate.

fields.name: Session__c
fields.label: Session
fields.description: The master Session this candidate is attending. Master-Detail so the attendee record is cleaned up if the Session goes away.

fields.name: Activate_From__c
fields.label: Activate From
fields.description: Date from which this session window becomes visible to candidates on the portal. Auto-populated by the sessionWindowCreator LWC to Start Date - 7 days at creation. Admin can override to open the booking window earlier or later.

fields.name: Booked_Count__c
fields.label: Booked Count
fields.description: Running count of candidates who have booked this session window. Incremented by CandidatePortalController.bookSessionWindow. Used by the slot picker to compute Slots Available = Candidate_Capacity - Booked_Count.

fields.name: Candidate_Capacity__c
fields.label: Candidate Capacity
fields.description: Maximum candidates that can register for this session window. Candidate portal enforces 5 as its hard limit; internal admins/trainers can raise this value beyond 5 for special cases.

fields.name: Cohort__c
fields.label: Cohort
fields.description: The cohort (batch / slot) this session window belongs to. Session windows recur across the days of the cohort's schedule.

fields.name: End_Time__c
fields.label: End Time
fields.description: End time of the session window. Computed by the Program Creation LWC as Start_Time + Program_Version.Session_Duration_Min, then written on save. Values < Start_Time indicate the window crosses midnight; runtime code interprets that as a next-day rollover.

fields.name: Sequence__c
fields.label: Sequence
fields.description: Display order of this window within the day. Determines the order presented to candidates in the booking picker.

fields.name: Start_Date__c
fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: Date this session window becomes active. Auto-populated from the parent Cohort's Start Date at creation time by the sessionWindowCreator LWC. Admin can override.

fields.name: Start_Time__c
fields.label: Start Time
fields.description: Start time of the session window in the program's time zone. Recurs every day of the program.

fields.name: Status__c
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of this session window. Upcoming = start date is in the future. Active = start date has arrived (portal can accept bookings / attendance). Completed = window has ended. Managed by admin / automation.

fields.name: Time_Zone__c
fields.label: Time Zone
fields.description: Time zone in which the Start Time and End Time are expressed. Uses the shared Candidate_Time_Zone global value set for consistency with Candidate_Training and Session records.

fields.name: Trainer__c
fields.label: Trainer
fields.description: Employee (Recruiter__c record) who hosts this session window.

fields.name: Window_Label__c
fields.label: Window Label
fields.description: Human-readable label for the session window (e.g. "Morning Batch", "Evening Batch").

fields.name: Org_Id__c
fields.label: Org Id
fields.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce Organization Id of the environment this record belongs to. The flow matches on this instead of DeveloperName, so environment detection is automatic and works in async context.
fields.helpText: Paste this org's Organization Id (Setup - Company Information). Used to auto-detect the environment.

fields.name: Reminder_Channel_Id__c
fields.label: slack_channel_followup_reminders
fields.description: Slack channel ID where final-round follow-up reminders are posted for this environment.
fields.helpText: Paste the Slack channel ID (starts with C). The Salesforce app must be invited to that channel.

fields.name: Triggers_Mock__c
fields.label: Triggers Mock
fields.description: When true and the parent Program Version has Mock_Frequency = "Custom (After Specific Steps)", a Mock Interview is scheduled after this step completes for the candidate. Ignored under other Mock_Frequency values.
